purpose: Current prayer effects and normal-game region dependencies merged into the app-facing prayer catalogue.

region_methodology.required_regions: Normal-game acquisition regions come from the canonical recursive quest graph plus the current content-source locality when an unlock is not quest-only.
region_methodology.league_override: Official Equilibrium quest auto-completion can remove normal-game quest gates later. Keep that as a separate overlay instead of rewriting these base requirements.
region_methodology.empty_regions: An empty required_regions array means the prayer has no region gate beyond its normal level or default-book requirements.
region_methodology.working_locality: City of Um, Gate of Elidinis and Sanctum of Rebirth use the project's historical Catalyst Misthalin mapping until Equilibrium publishes a locality override.
region_methodology.daemonheim: Daemonheim is a confirmed hard Forinthry requirement in Equilibrium.

effects.Clarity of Thought: Adds 2 Attack levels when calculating melee accuracy.
effects.Improved Reflexes: Adds 4 Attack levels when calculating melee accuracy.
effects.Incredible Reflexes: Adds 6 Attack levels when calculating melee accuracy.
effects.Sharp Eye: Adds 2 Ranged levels when calculating ranged accuracy.
effects.Hawk Eye: Adds 4 Ranged levels when calculating ranged accuracy.
effects.Eagle Eye: Adds 6 Ranged levels when calculating ranged accuracy.
effects.Mystic Will: Adds 2 Magic levels when calculating magic accuracy.
effects.Mystic Lore: Adds 4 Magic levels when calculating magic accuracy.
effects.Mystic Might: Adds 6 Magic levels when calculating magic accuracy.
effects.Hand of Judgement: Adds 2 Necromancy levels when calculating necromancy accuracy.
effects.Hand of Fate: Adds 4 Necromancy levels when calculating necromancy accuracy.
effects.Hand of Doom: Adds 6 Necromancy levels when calculating necromancy accuracy.
effects.Eclipsed Soul: Increases critical strike chance by 4%. After a critical strike, restores 1% of maximum life points each tick for 10 ticks, for up to 10% maximum life points over 6 seconds.
effects.Divine Rage: Increases melee, ranged, magic and necromancy damage by 5%.
effects.Thick Skin: Adds 2 Defence levels when calculating block chance.
effects.Rock Skin: Adds 4 Defence levels when calculating block chance.
effects.Steel Skin: Adds 6 Defence levels when calculating block chance.
effects.Chivalry: Adds 7 Attack levels for melee accuracy, increases melee damage by 7%, and adds 7 Defence levels for block chance.
effects.Piety: Adds 8 Attack levels for melee accuracy, increases melee damage by 8%, and adds 8 Defence levels for block chance.
effects.Rigour: Adds 8 Ranged levels for ranged accuracy, increases ranged damage by 8%, and adds 8 Defence levels for block chance.
effects.Augury: Adds 8 Magic levels for magic accuracy, increases magic damage by 8%, and adds 8 Defence levels for block chance.
effects.Sanctity: Adds 8 Necromancy levels for necromancy accuracy, increases necromancy damage by 8%, and adds 8 Defence levels for block chance.
effects.Rapid Heal: Doubles the normal life point regeneration rate.
effects.Rapid Renewal: Increases the normal life point regeneration rate to five times its base rate.
effects.Redemption: If life points fall below 10%, consumes the remaining Prayer points and heals 25 life points per Prayer level.
effects.Protect Item: Protects one additional item on death.
effects.Protect from Melee: Reduces incoming melee damage by 50% in PvM and 40% in PvP.
effects.Protect from Ranged: Reduces incoming ranged damage by 50% in PvM and 40% in PvP.
effects.Protect from Magic: Reduces incoming magic damage by 50% in PvM and 40% in PvP.
effects.Protect from Necromancy: Reduces incoming necromancy damage by 50% in PvM and 40% in PvP.
effects.Protect from Summoning: Reduces damage from Summoning familiars and protects against familiar special attacks.
effects.Rapid Restore: Doubles the natural restoration rate of lowered skills other than Constitution, Prayer and Summoning.
effects.Retribution: On death, damages nearby enemies for 15 times the player's Prayer level.
effects.Smite: When dealing damage to another player, removes 1 Prayer point from the target for every 40 damage dealt.
effects.Sap Melee Attack: Reduces the target's melee accuracy by 2 levels, stacking up to a 6-level reduction.
effects.Leech Melee Attack: Raises the user's melee accuracy by 2 to 5 levels while lowering the target's melee accuracy by 4 to 8 levels as the curse builds.
effects.Sap Melee Strength: Reduces the target's melee damage by 3%, stacking up to 9% in PvM. The PvP reduction is smaller.
effects.Leech Melee Strength: Raises the user's melee damage by 2% to 8% while lowering the target's melee damage by 6% to 12% in PvM as the curse builds.
effects.Turmoil: Adds 10 Attack levels for melee accuracy, increases melee damage by 10%, and adds 10 Defence levels for block chance. It also drains the target's melee and Defence combat values over time.
effects.Malevolence: Adds 12 Attack levels for melee accuracy, increases melee damage by 12%, and adds 12 Defence levels for block chance. It also applies the stronger high-level melee and Defence drain.
effects.Sap Magic Attack: Reduces the target's magic accuracy by 2 levels, stacking up to a 6-level reduction.
effects.Leech Magic Attack: Raises the user's magic accuracy by 2 to 5 levels while lowering the target's magic accuracy by 4 to 8 levels as the curse builds.
effects.Sap Magic Strength: Reduces the target's magic damage by 3%, stacking up to 9% in PvM. The PvP reduction is smaller.
effects.Leech Magic Strength: Raises the user's magic damage by 2% to 8% while lowering the target's magic damage by 6% to 12% in PvM as the curse builds.
effects.Light Form: Doubles the activation chance of Seren-aligned spell secondary effects while active.
effects.Dark Form: Doubles the activation chance of Ancient and Zaros-aligned spell secondary effects while active.
effects.Torment: Adds 10 Magic levels for magic accuracy, increases magic damage by 10%, and adds 10 Defence levels for block chance. It also drains the target's magic and Defence combat values over time.
effects.Affliction: Adds 12 Magic levels for magic accuracy, increases magic damage by 12%, and adds 12 Defence levels for block chance. It also applies the stronger high-level magic and Defence drain.
effects.Sap Ranged Attack: Reduces the target's ranged accuracy by 2 levels, stacking up to a 6-level reduction.
effects.Leech Ranged Attack: Raises the user's ranged accuracy by 2 to 5 levels while lowering the target's ranged accuracy by 4 to 8 levels as the curse builds.
effects.Sap Ranged Strength: Reduces the target's ranged damage by 3%, stacking up to 9% in PvM. The PvP reduction is smaller.
effects.Leech Ranged Strength: Raises the user's ranged damage by 2% to 8% while lowering the target's ranged damage by 6% to 12% in PvM as the curse builds.
effects.Anguish: Adds 10 Ranged levels for ranged accuracy, increases ranged damage by 10%, and adds 10 Defence levels for block chance. It also drains the target's ranged and Defence combat values over time.
effects.Desolation: Adds 12 Ranged levels for ranged accuracy, increases ranged damage by 12%, and adds 12 Defence levels for block chance. It also applies the stronger high-level ranged and Defence drain.
effects.Sap Necromancy Attack: Reduces the target's necromancy accuracy by 2 levels, stacking up to a 6-level reduction.
effects.Leech Necromancy Attack: Raises the user's necromancy accuracy by 2 to 5 levels while lowering the target's necromancy accuracy by 4 to 8 levels as the curse builds.
effects.Sap Necromancy Strength: Reduces the target's necromancy damage by 3%, stacking up to 9% in PvM. The PvP reduction is smaller.
effects.Leech Necromancy Strength: Raises the user's necromancy damage by 2% to 8% while lowering the target's necromancy damage by 6% to 12% in PvM as the curse builds.
effects.Sorrow: Adds 10 Necromancy levels for necromancy accuracy, increases necromancy damage by 10%, and adds 10 Defence levels for block chance. It also drains the target's necromancy and Defence combat values over time.
effects.Ruination: Adds 12 Necromancy levels for necromancy accuracy, increases necromancy damage by 12%, and adds 12 Defence levels for block chance. It also applies the stronger high-level necromancy and Defence drain.
effects.Sap Defence: Reduces the target's Defence level used for block chance by 2 levels, stacking up to a 6-level reduction.
effects.Leech Defence: Raises the user's Defence level used for block chance by 2 to 5 levels while lowering the target's by 4 to 8 levels as the curse builds.
effects.Fortitude: Increases Defence by 15%, reduces incoming damage by 3%, increases maximum life points by 10 plus 10 per Constitution level, increases defensive ability accuracy by 10%, doubles base life point regeneration, and allows natural regeneration during combat.
effects.Soul Link: Links to another player within 5 squares and shares half of incoming damage and healing between the linked players.
effects.Soul Split: Heals the user for 10% of damage dealt and drains 1 Prayer point from the target for every 66 damage dealt.
effects.Sap Adrenaline: Periodically drains 10% adrenaline from the target as attacks land.
effects.Leech Adrenaline: Periodically drains adrenaline from the target and transfers the drained adrenaline to the user.
effects.Deflect Summoning: Reduces damage from Summoning familiars, protects against familiar special attacks, and can reflect part of familiar damage back to the attacker.
effects.Deflect Magic: Reduces incoming magic damage by 50% in PvM and 40% in PvP, with a chance to reflect part of the blocked damage.
effects.Deflect Ranged: Reduces incoming ranged damage by 50% in PvM and 40% in PvP, with a chance to reflect part of the blocked damage.
effects.Deflect Melee: Reduces incoming melee damage by 50% in PvM and 40% in PvP, with a chance to reflect part of the blocked damage.
effects.Deflect Necromancy: Reduces incoming necromancy damage by 50% in PvM and 40% in PvP, with a chance to reflect part of the blocked damage.
effects.Teamwork Protection: For each nearby player also using Teamwork Protection, grants 5% damage reduction and 1% damage reflection, up to five contributors for 25% reduction and 5% reflection.
effects.Chronicle Attraction: Automatically attracts and captures chronicle fragments while training Divination.
effects.Superheat Form: Automatically burns logs while Woodcutting, speeds smelting by 0.6 seconds, and treats low and medium smithing heat as the next higher heat band.
effects.Leech Run Energy: Periodically steals 10% run energy from the target.
effects.Berserker: Makes temporary boosted combat stats last 15% longer before decaying.
effects.Wrath: On death, damages nearby enemies around the player.
